shared_elements: schematic figures with limbs rendered against a stone surface
figures shown frontally/in profile with raised or extended arms
small repeated marks (dots in A, repeated band elements in B)
justification: Both show schematic, limbed figures set on a stone surface, and both include isolated linear rods and small repeated marks, but that is generic to most rock imagery. The decisive difference is technique and composition: A is flat red pigment painting of two human figures loosely scattered across an irregular horizontal boulder face, while B is low-relief carving of animals arranged in stacked registers beneath a horizontal patterned band on a shaped vertical pillar.
